Supreme Court hears Gulf students' plea on CBSE assessment scheme

The Supreme Court has sought a response from the government and the CBSE regarding a plea filed by students based in the Gulf. These students are challenging the assessment scheme used after the cancellation of their Class 12 examinations, arguing it has negatively impacted their marks and higher education prospects. The court is examining the formula used for their evaluation.
